title: 3 Lies You've Been Told About Money

segments.text: You're believing myths that keep you broke.
Like thinking you need a big salary to save.
That’s simply not true. Wealth is built gradually.
And waiting for the 'right time' to start?
You can start right now with what you have.
Want to break free from money myths? Follow me.

description: Uncover the lies about money that hold you back. Follow to challenge your beliefs and build real wealth. 💡
